title: NADDIC GAMES
description: naddic.com Naddic Games Co., Ltd — South Korean action RPG studio founded January 2012 in Seoul by ex-Elsword developers, ~93 employees, CEO Lee Sun-joo, built on its own engine and "Action DNA" cross-platform tech. Flagship IP is CLOSERS, anime-style urban-fantasy action MORPG for PC — launched 2014 with Nexon, Steam 2018, self-published globally after En Masse/Krafton collapse in 2020. Portfolio also includes 22+ mobile games via merged studio Mafgames, while the mobile sequel ClosersRT: New Order (2023) flopped and shut down in a month. Business model = F2P microtransactions + regional licensing (Nexon KR, Tian City CN, Papaya Play global reboot Aug 2026, 101XP CIS). Financials are weak: revenue crashed 18B to 8.7B KRW (2021-2024), 4 straight operating-loss years, full capital impairment (equity -43B KRW), massive layoffs 200+ to 93 staff, though 2025 rebounded to 10.9B revenue with loss cut to -0.8B. Acquired Sept 2024 by Taiwanese-Korean publisher HappyTuk (TWSE: 7584) — 92.23%.
